_comment: Copy to config/vocab.json (gitignored) to rename, recolour, add or drop vocabulary without editing code.
Every top-level key is optional. Inside status/buckets/stages/kinds/cadence, a key that matches a built-in entry
replaces only the fields you give (so {"label": "Prospect"} renames without touching emoji/colour); a key that
does not exist is added; the special list "remove" drops built-in entries. Built-in keys: see lib/vocab.mjs.
Keys (new, this_week, identified, …) are what the database stores — change labels, emoji and colours freely, but
keep the keys of anything rows already use. The app falls back to new / this_week / identified / engagement, so keep those.
"color" is a palette name, one of: emerald, sky, orange, slate, violet, green, red, zinc, amber, stone, indigo,
fuchsia, teal, blue, rose, yellow (anything else renders as stone). "order" sorts entries; omitted = appended.
A kind with "separate": true (built-in: job) is listed after the others on the pipeline board, on a card tinted in its colour.
Restart the app and the MCP server after changing this file.
